subject: [PATCH for-7.5 5/5] memcg: simplify high limit handling after a charge

2026-10-10.patch_summary: This patch simplifies the handling of high limits in memory cgroups by separating the hierarchy scan from high-limit enforcement. It introduces a new variable to track whether the task is running in user context, and uses this information to determine whether to queue high_work or record the task's overage after scanning the hierarchy. The patch also clarifies comments and removes redundant code, but does not introduce any functional changes.
